    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActivityMonitor
    Turns snapshots of the open editors into EventType.EDIT, EventType.IDLE_START and EventType.IDLE_END events.
    ClassAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's class events into the plugin's class events.
    CompileAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's compile events into EventType.COMPILE_SUCCESS and EventType.COMPILE_ERROR events.
    EditorActivityPoller
    Every few seconds, reads the text length of each open editor and passes the numbers to the ActivityMonitor, which decides what counts as an edit or idle time.
    EventSerialiser
    Turns a session and its events into text in some output format.
    EventType
    The kinds of student activity the plugin records.
    ExportMenuGenerator
    Adds the option/button "Export Telemetry Report" to BlueJ's Tools menu, so the student can save the JSON and PDF for the session so far at any time.
    ExportPackageListener
    Starts a session when a project opens, and saves the session's JSON and PDF into the project's folder when it closes.
    ExportService
    Runs every report exporter for a session.
    InvocationAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's "method call finished" events (when the student runs a method from BlueJ's interface) into EventType.RUN_FINISHED or EventType.RUN_EXCEPTION events.
    JsonEventSerialiser
    Writes a session as a JSON document with three parts: session (details and times), summary (compile counts and timing) and events (every event in time order, each with an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp).
    JsonReportExporter
    Saves a session as a .json file, using any EventSerialiser to produce the text.
    MethodAdapter
    Adapter: after each successful compile the student starts, asks BlueJ for the compiled classes' methods and publishes a EventType.METHOD_ADDED event for each new one.
    MethodTracker
    Remembers each class's methods from its last successful compile, so the methods added since then can be reported.
    PackageAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's package events into EventType.PROJECT_OPENED and EventType.PROJECT_CLOSED events.
    PdfReportExporter
    Saves a session as a .pdf report, using PdfReportMaker.
    PdfReportMaker
    Draws a ReportData as a PDF report using Apache PDFBox ReportData.
    PdfReportMaker.Canvas
    Keeps track of the current page and how far down it has been written, and starts a new page automatically when there is no room left.
    RecordedSession
    A finished ession: its details plus the events recorded during it.
    ReportData
    Works out everything the PDF report shows.
    ReportExporter
    ReportExporter.export(SessionInfo, List, File) fixes the steps for saving a report (work out the file name, then write the file), and each subclass supplies only the format-specific parts: ReportExporter.extension() and ReportExporter.write(SessionInfo, List, File).
    SessionInfo
    The details that identify one coding session: who, which project, and when.
    SessionRecorder
    Observer that keeps the events for the current session only.
    SessionStatistics
    Calculates the summary numbers for a session from its events: event count, successful and failed compilations, and the average time between compiles.
    StudentIdPreferences
    Adds a "Telemetry student ID" text input box to BlueJ's Tools -> Preferences -> Extensions panel.
    TelemetryCollector
    Receives every telemetry event and passes it on to all subscribed TelemetryObservers.
    TelemetryEvent
    One recorded student action: what happened (EventType), when, and any details.
    TelemetryEventFactory
    Creates TelemetryEvents with the correct type, data keys and current time, so the rest of the plugin never builds events by hand.
    TelemetryExtension
    BlueJ creates this class when it starts and calls TelemetryExtension.startup(BlueJ), which builds every part of the plugin and connects them
    TelemetryObserver
